mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production and housing starts over the prior three months indicate broad economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline by at least 0.5% from their 3-month prior values.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.5% and strong labor growth), a 3-month unemployment rate rise exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals cycle end, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the prior three months signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days across all regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening expectations that depress S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate over the prior three months indicate dual monetary tightening and economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (low industrial production growth), a 3-month decline in industrial production signals acute supply disruption, generating negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines > 0.3% in 3 months during supply-constrained regimes.
